WITH v AS (
 SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn,
  MIN(valid_from) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) minvf,
  COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) njoin
 FROM dim_member)
SELECT count(*) first_rows,
 sum(CASE WHEN valid_from = join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vf_eq_join,
 sum(CASE WHEN valid_from < join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vf_before_join,
 sum(CASE WHEN valid_from > join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vf_after_join,
 sum(CASE WHEN njoin>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_join,
 sum(CASE WHEN join_date > DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) future
FROM v WHERE rn=1

calls.statement:
WITH fv AS (
 SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn
 FROM dim_member)
SELECT fv.home_store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, count(*) new_members, count(distinct fv.member_id) dm,
  min(join_date) mn, max(join_date) mx
FROM fv JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE fv.rn=1 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1

WITH fv AS (
 SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn
 FROM dim_member)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, count(*) n, count(distinct join_date) days, sum(CASE WHEN home_store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web,
 sum(CASE WHEN home_store_id>=999 OR home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) odd
FROM fv JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=fv.join_date
WHERE rn=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
